citations.assessment: At Yoma 6:6:9, Zakkai recites the impurity of the clothing of an outsider who burned the offerings. This attests the locator independently of the adjacent Chanina transmission.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The pointed Heilprin entry supplies the exact Yerushalmi Megillah locator. That passage expressly calls Chanina’s source Rabbi Zakkai of Kavul, whereas Yoma does not name a place for the Zakkai in its passage.

holds.reason: The exact Megillah passage gives Zakkai of Kavul; Yoma gives the name alone. The relationship of the two notices is open.
